title: GitHub - lacework-alliances/lacework-control-tower-cfn: AWS Control Tower and Lacework allow seamless multi-account cloud security. With Lacework and AWS Control Tower, enrolling a new AWS account now means security best practices and monitoring are automatically applied consistently across your organization. Account administrators can automatically add Lacework's security auditing and monitoring to new AWS accounts. All the required Lacework and AWS account configurations that allow access to AWS configuration and AWS CloudTrail logs are managed for you by Lacework’s AWS Control Tower integration.
